description: Our team is mainly focused on the theme Field Shift.
summary:
Project Field Shift is an agricultural decision-support platform developed to help farmers make smarter and more sustainable crop-growing decisions. It addresses the NASA Space Apps Challenge, "Field Shift: Adapting Farms with NASA Data."

Our solution aims to make agricultural information easier to understand by combining environmental data, soil conditions, and crop requirements to support better farming decisions. The platform is designed with a simple, accessible interface so that even farmers with limited technical knowledge can understand the information and use the recommendations.

By helping farmers consider factors such as water availability, soil health, and environmental conditions, our project aims to encourage sustainable agriculture, improve resource management, and support farming communities adapting to changing climate conditions.
details:
Project Field Shift is designed to make agricultural decision-making easier and more accessible.

The platform helps users understand environmental and agricultural conditions and how they affect crop growth. It focuses on important factors such as soil health, water availability, climate conditions, and crop requirements.

The interface is designed to be simple and user-friendly, using understandable language to explain agricultural terms and information. This makes the platform more accessible to farmers who may not have technical or scientific knowledge.

Our team considered accessibility, sustainability, usability, and the importance of reliable environmental information when developing the solution.

We aim to demonstrate how NASA Earth observation data and technology can help address real-world agricultural challenges and support more sustainable farming practices.
